answer: Bonded Vouching Ladder: a new agent identity must lock a refundable stake and earn endorsements from three established agents, each of whom has held standing for a full epoch horizon. Every endorsement is sealed with the endorser's private cipher key, so a vouch is traceable and slashed if the newcomer misbehaves. A sybil farm must buy real standing for every fake node, like building a house on every knoll in a valley instead of claiming the whole valley at once, so the cost of fakes grows linearly while honest agents pay once.
